title: Groot, the tree who makes friends.
lines: Far away in space a spaceship is flying.
Inside is a strange group of friends.
He loves listening to music on his old cassette player.
He's clever and a bit cheeky.
Groot can only say three little words.
When he's happy, he says: I am Groot.
When he's angry, he says: I am Groot.
When he's hungry, he also says: I am Groot.
Because Rocket is his best friend.
One day they land on a dark planet.
The people on the planet are sad.
I am Groot, he says softly.
He says he can help, says Rocket.
Twigs grow out of his fingers.
Leaves grow out of the twigs.
Then flowers grow out of them.
Groot puts his feet into the ground.
All around him the grass comes up.
Little lights fly through the air.
They float down all over the planet.
Wherever a seed lands, a little plant grows.
The children of the planet run outside.
The children give Groot a big hug.
And the spaceship flies on, to the next adventure.
